label: Collectibles & Figures
description: Collectible formats as products in their own right — the scale figure, the blind-box vinyl, the boxed model kit. Each names the material, finish and presentation that make it read as a manufactured object rather than a render.

items.name: scale-figure-1-7
items.text: a 1/7 scale PVC collectible figure on a clear acrylic base, factory paint with clean separation lines, subtle gloss on the eyes and matte on the fabric, sculpted folds holding real weight
items.text_short: 1/7 scale PVC figure on acrylic base

items.name: chibi-deformed-figure
items.text: a super-deformed chibi figure, two heads tall, thick simplified forms, glossy factory finish, sat on a small themed base
items.text_short: chibi SD figure, two heads tall, glossy

items.name: blind-box-vinyl
items.text: a blind-box vinyl toy: soft rounded forms, flat matte colour blocking, a single glossy accent, the deliberate blankness of designer vinyl

items.name: action-figure-blister
items.text: an action figure sealed in a blister pack: articulated joints visible through the bubble, printed cardback behind, small accessories in their own moulded wells

items.name: model-kit-sprue
items.text: an unbuilt model kit on its sprue: parts laid out in a grid on the runner with numbered gates, injection-moulded plastic sheen
items.text_short: model kit parts on numbered sprue

items.name: diorama-base
items.text: a figure mounted on a built diorama base — textured groundwork, weathering pigments, a scenic element sized to the figure

items.name: plush-toy
items.text: a soft plush toy: short pile fabric, embroidered features, visible seams and stuffed volume that flattens where it rests

items.name: brick-minifig
items.text: a brick-built minifigure and micro-scene: moulded plastic parts with printed detail, studs visible, primary-colour palette
